report_name: Ransomware Attacks Hit Record High, NCC Group Reports

threat_actors.name: Qilin
threat_actors.description: Identified as one of the most prolific ransomware groups in August 2026, responsible for 164 incidents. It operates within the Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) model and often uses phishing for initial access.

threat_actors.name: The Gentlemen
threat_actors.description: A dominant ransomware group active in August 2026, responsible for 116 attacks.

threat_actors.name: Clop
threat_actors.description: A major ransomware group responsible for 89 incidents in August 2026. Known for exploiting zero-day vulnerabilities in public-facing applications like MOVEit Transfer.

threat_actors.name: Dire Wolf
threat_actors.description: A ransomware group active in August 2026, responsible for 43 incidents.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: Used by ransomware groups like Clop for initial access by exploiting zero-day or n-day vulnerabilities in internet-facing software such as MOVEit Transfer.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: A primary initial access vector for groups like Qilin, used to deliver malicious payloads via email.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
attack_patterns.description: Used by attackers to exfiltrate large volumes of sensitive data to their own servers for double extortion before data encryption.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The final stage of a traditional ransomware attack where files on critical systems are encrypted to disrupt business operations and demand a ransom.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: Attackers delete volume shadow copies using tools like vssadmin.exe to prevent easy system restoration from local backups.

malware.name: Qilin Ransomware
malware.description: Ransomware used by the Qilin threat group in their attacks. The group was one of the most prolific in August 2026.

malware.name: Clop Ransomware
malware.description: Ransomware used by the Clop group, which was responsible for 89 incidents in August 2026.

malware.name: INC Ransom
malware.description: A ransomware variant active in August 2026, responsible for 43 incidents.

tools.name: vssadmin
tools.description: Used by ransomware attackers to delete volume shadow copies to prevent system restoration, as indicated by the command `vssadmin.exe delete shadows /all /quiet`.

vulnerabilities.name: MOVEit Transfer Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Vulnerabilities in public-facing applications like MOVEit Transfer were exploited by groups like Clop for initial access.

identities.name: Manchester Airport Group
identities.description: Victim of a data theft and extortion attack where attackers focused solely on data theft without encryption.

identities.name: Industrials Sector
identities.description: The most targeted industry sector in August 2026, accounting for 31% of all ransomware incidents.

identities.name: Consumer Goods and Services Sector
identities.description: A frequently targeted industry sector, accounting for 18% of ransomware attacks in August 2026.

identities.name: Healthcare Sector
identities.description: A frequently targeted industry sector, accounting for 12% of ransomware attacks in August 2026.

identities.name: Information Technology Sector
identities.description: A frequently targeted industry sector, accounting for 11% of ransomware attacks in August 2026.

infrastructure.name: Attacker Exfiltration Servers
infrastructure.description: Servers used by ransomware groups to store large volumes of sensitive data stolen from victims for double extortion purposes.

indicators.name: Ransomware File Extension Creation
indicators.pattern:
title: Ransomware File Extension Creation
id: f1a2b3c4-d5e6-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of files with extensions known to be used by ransomware groups like Qilin and Clop.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-24
tags:
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.qilin'
      - '.clop'
  condition: selection

indicators.name: Common Ransom Note File Creation
indicators.pattern:
title: Common Ransom Note File Creation
id: 1a2b3c4d-5e6f-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5e
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of common ransom note filenames. This may indicate a ransomware infection in its final stages.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-24
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate files named 'readme.txt'. The rule is more reliable if correlated with other suspicious activity.
tags:
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.impact
level: medium
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\readme.txt'
      - '\decrypt-me.txt'
  condition: selection

indicators.name: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
id: 2b3c4d5e-6f7a-4b8c-9d0e-1f2a3b4c5d6f
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common ransomware TTP to inhibit system recovery.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-24
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
